task: Construct the same flat four-layer carbonate reference velocity field on a common nodal grid
purpose: Executable cross-tool coordinate/value control and scoped output-construction timings; not a realistic-basin, history-physics or downstream FWI ranking
output: Full velocity array, binary64, shape (nz,ny,nx), x fastest, CPU resident

numericGate.reference: Independent analytic carbonate Raymer-Hunt-Gardner formula using explicitly supplied bulk grain fraction; no fit to generated output

scopeDifferences: Earth Forge uses an explicit initial material stack and evaluates its rock law; there are no history events or compaction in this control
SubsurfaceGen uses four flat Deposit modules with zero gradient, boundary roughness and texture; expansion_mode=false
Both return f64 fields; SubsurfaceGen retains some internal float32 index arithmetic in its published implementation
Earth Forge time includes native process startup, JSON output including bed labels/diagnostics, and decoding; SubsurfaceGen runs its PyTorch modules in process and materializes a NumPy copy
Source imports, native engine discovery and package setup measured separately; full module/model construction is included per trial
No smoothing, velocity clipping, faulting, stochastic geology, seismic propagation or GPU execution in this control
Do not generalize these timings to complete geological histories or the field-scale published dataset
revisionReason: The initial default-taper control failed the unchanged 1e-8 m/s reference gate (SubsurfaceGen maximum error 0.00021763808217656333 m/s). Inspection found an internal float32 flat_deposit branch in the optional surface taper. For the constant flat-field task, both taper fractions are now explicitly zero via the published API. No third-party source or acceptance threshold changed. Original plan/failure preserved; this is configuration-specific, not a general numerical-accuracy ranking.
